harness_resolution: Attempted middle-button pan omitted Alt. Camera::OnEvent requires mods==ALT and middleDown. The five false pan predicates are invalid stimulus assumptions, not product defects. Unchanged receipts retained; initial/F/menu framing independently confirms UI18.
cause: TimeOfImpact creates direct preview geometry but zero physics bodies. It inherits FocusBounds=false; F falls through to FocusHome/world bounds, and menu Frame Camera also uses world bounds. Neither frames the actual preview. GPU fallback world bounds and CPU empty bounds explain different camera responses.
limits: Frustum analysis uses actual UI camera rounded to 0.1 and actual draw poses, proxy-derived bounding sphere radius about .22, FOV50 from main.cpp. All outside margins are substantial; no exact pixel assertion.
UI18 runtime confirmation is Time of Impact only. Other zero-body tools share the potential world-bounds path but are not runtime framing-qualified.
The constructor camera default and original geometry/sweeps were preserved.
